```{r}
#| echo: false

  "bootstrap_hazard_curve", "SpreadCdsHelper, PiecewiseFlatHazardRate",
  "build_ois_curve", "OISRateHelper, DepositRateHelper, PiecewiseLogCubicDiscount, PiecewiseLogLinearDiscount",
  "calibrate_sabr", "None in the R binding; R optim around sabrVolatility",
  "cds_maturity", "cdsMaturity",
  "cds_quote_sensitivity", "None; finite difference with a rebuilt curve",
  "cds_value", "MidPointCdsEngine, IsdaCdsEngine",

  "compound_yield_from_price", "None; GaussQuant R",
  "convexity", "BondFunctions_convexity",
  "credit_default_swap", "Schedule, CreditDefaultSwap",
  "curve_node_sensitivity", "None; finite difference on DiscountCurve",
  "curve_values", "YieldTermStructure_discount, _zeroRate, _forwardRate",
  "curve_values_batch", "None; a loop",
  "dirty_price", "Clean price plus accrued amount",
  "discount", "YieldTermStructure_discount",
  "discount_nodes", "curve dates and data",
  "duration", "BondFunctions_duration",
  "european_option", "VanillaOption, AnalyticEuropeanEngine",
  "forward_option", "blackFormula, bachelierBlackFormula, BlackCalculator",
  "forward_rate", "YieldTermStructure_forwardRate",
  "future_basis", "None; QuantLib values with R arithmetic",
  "future_basket", "None; QuantLib values with R arithmetic",
  "hazard_curve", "FlatHazardRate",
  "holidays", "Calendar_holidayList",
  "hull_white_bermudan_swaption", "BermudanExercise, TreeSwaptionEngine (another method)",
  "hull_white_bond_option", "None in the R binding; R closed form",
  "hull_white_callable_bond", "None for this method; legacy R function",
  "hull_white_swaption", "JamshidianSwaptionEngine",
  "implied_volatility", "VanillaOption impliedVolatility",
  "is_business_day", "Calendar_isBusinessDay",
  "monte_carlo_european", "None compared; different random numbers",
  "ois_asset_swap", "None; GaussQuant R on a QuantLib curve",
  "ois_instruments", "None; the helpers of the curve",

  "price_from_compound_yield", "None; GaussQuant R",
  "price_from_simple_rate", "None; GaussQuant R",
  "quote_repricing", "Helper impliedQuote and dates",

  "sabr_volatility", "sabrVolatility (lognormal); none for normal",
  "settlement_date", "Bond_settlementDate",
  "simple_rate_from_price", "None; GaussQuant R",
  "survival_probability", "survivalProbability",
  "value_on_curve", "DiscountingBondEngine",
  "with_extrapolation", "TermStructure_enableExtrapolation",
  "yen_asset_swap", "None; GaussQuant R on QuantLib curves",
  "yield_from_price", "BondFunctions_yield",
  "yield_sensitivity", "None; duration and convexity of BondFunctions",
  "yield_value_basis_point", "BondFunctions_yieldValueBasisPoint",
  "zero_rate", "YieldTermStructure_zeroRate",
  "fixed_rate_bond", "Schedule, FixedRateBond"
)
exports <- getNamespaceExports("RiemannFinMath") |> sort()
chapter_files <- list.files("chapters", pattern = "^ch.*qmd$", full.names = TRUE)
uses <- map(chapter_files, \(f) {
  text <- readLines(f, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE) |> paste(collapse = "\n")
  found <- str_match_all(text, "RiemannFinMath::([a-z_0-9]+)")[[1]][, 2] |> unique()
  tibble(fn = found, chapter = str_extract(basename(f), "ch[0-9]+"))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  summarise(Chapters = paste(sort(unique(chapter)), collapse = ", "), .by = fn)
coverage <- tibble(fn = exports) |>
  left_join(counterparts, by = "fn") |>
  left_join(uses, by = "fn") |>
  arrange(fn)
stopifnot(!anyNA(coverage$quantlib))
coverage |>
  transmute(Function = paste0("`", fn, "`"), `QuantLib side` = quantlib, Chapters = replace_na(Chapters, "not called")) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: coverage
#| echo: false
tibble(`Exported functions` = nrow(coverage), `Called in a chapter` = sum(!is.na(coverage$Chapters))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
